meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 把文章、笔记或某个主题变成一部‘无人出镜’的解说视频。画面全部由 Claude 现编——用排版、抽象图形、图表等来表示每一幕；它会规划讲解脚本、配旁白和背景音乐，最终输出一个 mp4 视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户给出一段文字（如文章、笔记、主题等），要求做成无人出镜的解说视频时触发；典型用于主题讲解、概念拆解、操作教程等。若意图是基于网站做宣传片/导览，或不确定，则不触发，转交 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把这篇关于复利的文章做成无人出镜的解说视频。
say.note: Claude 会先规划分镜，再生成视频。

say.text: 我想做一个讲解‘光合作用’概念的视频，不要真人出镜。
say.note: Claude 将制作概念讲解视频，画面全部现编。

say.text: 把这份操作笔记变成3分钟的教程视频，逐帧讲清楚。
say.note: Claude 会按步骤生成分镜和旁白。

howto.what_en: Turns text (article, notes, topic, etc.) into a faceless explainer video: Claude invents each scene's visuals (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, etc.), plans a storyboard, adds narration/BGM, and renders an mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when text (e.g., article, notes, topic, etc.) is turned into a faceless explainer video (topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, etc.). Not for site-based promos/tours; unclear → /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this article about compound interest into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Claude plans the storyboard first, then renders the video.

say_en.text: Make a faceless explainer video about the concept of photosynthesis.
say_en.note: Claude makes a concept explainer; all visuals are invented.

say_en.text: Turn these how-to notes into a 3-minute tutorial video, frame by frame.
say_en.note: Claude generates the storyboard and narration step by step.
